## Checklist

### For all PRs:
- [ ] Code builds without errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] No TypeScript errors (`npx tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`npm run lint`)

### For PRs to `dev`:
- [ ] Feature is complete and working locally
- [ ] Tested voice commands (if applicable)
- [ ] Tested UI interactions (if applicable)

### For PRs to `master` (production):
- [ ] Tested on dev branch for at least 1 session
- [ ] No console.log debug statements
- [ ] All TODO comments addressed or documented
- [ ] Railway environment variables updated (if needed)
